输入安装时生成的管理员令牌: Enter the administrator token generated during installation
当前连接未使用 HTTPS。公网或不可信网络上不要输入管理员令牌。: This connection does not use HTTPS. Do not enter an administrator token on a public or untrusted network.
当前服务使用自签 HTTPS 证书。连接已加密，但请通过可信渠道核对下方 SHA: This service uses a self-signed HTTPS certificate. The connection is encrypted, but verify the SHA-256 fingerprint below through a trusted channel before trusting it. You can replace the certificate in Access settings and restart the service.
每条规则可选择 nftables flowtable 优先或强制 GO；跨地址族: Choose nftables flowtable preferred or forced GO for each rule. Cross-family traffic always uses the Go proxy.
只按直接连接来源 IP 判断，不信任代理请求头。: Access is based only on the direct peer IP; proxy headers are not trusted.
自动授权本机局域网接口网段: Automatically allow local LAN interface subnets
安装和升级后强制 HTTPS；未提供证书时会自动生成有效期 10 年的自签证书。: HTTPS is required after installation and upgrades. Without a certificate, a 10-year self-signed certificate is generated. Only 127.0.0.1/::1 are bound by default; remote access requires listener and allowlist configuration.
严格模式只允许回环地址和下方手动白名单，忽略自动 LAN 与启动参数临时授权，并: Strict mode allows only loopback and the manual allowlist below, ignores automatic LAN and bootstrap allowances, and requires native TLS. Configure a certificate, restart and sign in over HTTPS before enabling it. Apply the same source restrictions in the host firewall.
自定义 DNS 服务器（每行一个，留空使用系统 DNS）: Custom DNS servers (one per line; empty uses system DNS)
自定义 DNS 使用普通 UDP/TCP DNS，请只填写可信本地解析器；需要加: Custom DNS uses plain UDP/TCP DNS. Use trusted local resolvers only. For encrypted DNS, deploy a trusted local DoT/DoH stub and enter its local address.
替换正式证书：将证书和私钥放到服务器，填写上方绝对路径、保存并重启服务；同路径续: To replace the certificate, place the certificate and key on the server, enter their absolute paths, save and restart. Renewal at the same path also requires a restart. The displayed certificate is the one loaded by the running process. Minimum TLS defaults to 1.2; 1.3 is optional. Private-key permissions may be 0600 owned by portbridge or 0640 root:portbridge; directories must be readable by the service account.
网卡地址变化后会周期性刷新。: Refreshed periodically after interface address changes.
nftables 优先：外部同族流量使用内核 flowtable 快速路径，本机: nftables preferred: external same-family traffic uses the kernel flowtable fast path; local output uses nftables NAT; cross-family and loopback fallback use Go. GO forces the entire rule through the Go proxy.
端口段必须等长，例如 10000–10099 → 20000–20099；最多: Port ranges must have equal length, e.g. 10000–10099 → 20000–20099; at most 4096 ports.
允许目标解析到本地/私有/链路地址（需下方 CIDR 精确授权）: Allow local/private/link-local targets (requires explicit CIDRs below)
域名每次刷新都会重新校验全部 A/AAAA 结果，防止 DNS 重绑定。未明确授: Every DNS refresh revalidates all A/AAAA results against DNS rebinding. Loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT, multicast and cloud metadata addresses are rejected without explicit authorization.
仅作用于 Go UDP 数据面。Worker 是整条规则共享的预算（端口段/双栈: Applies only to the Go UDP data plane. Workers share one rule-wide budget across port ranges and address families. Zero selects automatically from GOMAXPROCS; each listening socket gets at least one worker. Defaults: batch 64, packet buffer 2048 B.
计数仅含 Go 跨族路径: Counters cover Go cross-family paths only
已保存。安全模式、TLS、监听地址或端口变更需重启服务；重启前当前进程配置不变。: Saved. Changes to security mode, TLS, listener addresses or port require a service restart; the running configuration is unchanged until then.
轮换后当前令牌立即失效。继续吗？: Rotation invalidates the current token immediately. Continue?
当前进程使用自签证书。: The running process uses a self-signed certificate.
当前进程使用非自签证书，信任状态由客户端验证。: The running process uses a non-self-signed certificate; clients validate trust.
